annotations.title: Compute one engine fact for a chart

description: Reviewer/developer tool. Computes one fact of one engine (see list_engines) for a deterministic chart, as of asOfDate for period and transit facts. Returns null in value when the chart cannot answer it.

args.description: Arguments matching the fact's schema in list_engines

engine.description: Engine id from list_engines, for example natal, dasha, kp

place.description: Catalogue query or display label when explicit coordinates are supplied

timezone.description: Required IANA timezone when explicit coordinates are supplied, for example Asia/Kolkata

timezoneOffset.description: Optional fallback offset; derived from timezone and the requested local date when omitted

name: run_engine
title: Compute one engine fact for a chart
